title: Desk Note on Booking a Metal Market Repricing to a Commission
content:
# Desk Note on Booking a Metal Market Repricing to a Commission

Where the metal price behind the quote on a commission under Belrose Design Studio Custom Commissions has aged past the programme's revaluation window, the repricing for that movement in the metal market falls due and is booked to the commission, raising what the customer owes on it. Under the programmes that do not pass the metal market through, the chain absorbs the movement and no adjustment is booked.

## What the booking does

One call adds a single adjustment entry to the commission under the metal market reason, raising what the customer owes on that commission by the amount given while the quoted total, the design revisions and the production stage stay exactly as they are. The customer sees the adjustment on their commission file.

## How the repricing is booked

The repricing is booked on the studio's own tool `charge_metal_revaluation_a0bcb90e`. The tool is unlocked and then called by the desk.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Form |
|---|---|---|
| `custom_order_id` | The commission record the adjustment is booked against | An identifier, as read from the design studio's commission lookup for this customer |
| `commission_reference` | The reference the customer is given for the commission being repriced | CO- followed by six digits, for example CO-509314, exactly as it stands on the commission record |
| `metal_adjustment_amount` | The amount booked against the commission for the movement in the metal market | In USD, to 2 decimal places, rounded half up, positive, with no thousands separator and no currency symbol |

## What comes back

A single line of text confirming the adjustment was booked. It names the new commission entry's reference number, the commission reference it was booked to and the amount booked in USD to two decimal places. Receiving that line is what indicates the commission now carries the adjustment.
